item.title: Show HN: Mint MCP – Generate 3D assets from coding agents
item.summary: Hi HN, I and my co founder built Mint MCP, a remote server that lets Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor create 3D models, worlds, materials, images, and audio. The server handles long-running jobs, preview revisions, partial failures, and file delivery. When generation finishes, Mint gives the agent stable links to the files and tells it what each file is for, so it can add them to the project. You can try it at mcp.mint.gg. It requires a Mint subscription but msg me and i can set you up with some free credits! I’d like feedback from anyone using coding agents for 3D or asset-heavy projects. We have a massive repo of open source templates for you to use/play around with on play.mint.gg Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49176574 Points: 2 # Comments: 0
